text: SOCIAL! Everyone takes a sip together.
Pick someone to be your drinking buddy. When one drinks, both drink.
Group decides: someone takes a shot OR 3 people each take 2 sips.
Flip a coin. Heads = give out 5 sips. Tails = take 5 sips.
Host pours a mystery mix. Take a sip or make someone else take 2.
Roast someone in the room for 15 seconds or take 4 sips.
Everyone votes: who's most likely to black out tonight? That person takes 3 sips.
Dare someone to do something. They can accept or drink 4. You decide the dare.
WATERFALL! Can't stop until the person before you stops.
NEW RULE: Every time someone says 'like', they take a sip.
Make a rule. Anyone who breaks it this game takes 2 sips.
Pick 2 people. They have to hold hands until the next card or both drink.
Sip or Strip: Take off an item of clothing or take 3 sips.
Switch drinks with the person to your left for the next round.
Last person to raise their hand takes 3 sips.
Give someone a lap dance for 10 seconds or take 5 sips.
You're now the Question Master. Anyone who answers your questions drinks until next card.
Everyone closes eyes. Point at who you think is the wildest. Most votes drinks.
Pick someone. They finish their drink or you finish yours.
Start a chant about someone. If they blush, they drink. If not, you drink.
Dance battle with someone of your choice. Loser takes 4 sips.
Everyone born in an even month drinks.
Swap phones with someone for the rest of the round or take 4 sips.
NEW RULE: Must maintain eye contact while drinking. Break contact = extra sip.
Hot seat: Group asks you 3 questions. Skip any = 2 sips each.
Pick someone. Rock paper scissors. Loser takes a shot or chugs for 5 seconds.
Compliment everyone in the room or take 5 sips.
Mimic the person to your right until the next card. Break character = sip.
Point at who you'd want to see more of tonight. If they point back, both drink.
Confess who in this room you'd kiss. They decide if you drink or they drink.
Viking rules! Make Viking horns with your hands. Neighbors row. Last to react drinks.
Give out sips equal to the number of people you've kissed this year (max 5).
Tell an embarrassing story about someone here or take 3 sips.
Arm around the person to your left until next card. Drop it = both drink.
NEW RULE: Snake Eyes! If you make eye contact with someone, both drink.
Category: Things you'd whisper to someone. First to hesitate or get weird drinks.
Vote: Who's the biggest flirt here? They give out 3 sips.
Sit on someone's lap until the next card or take 4 sips.
Call someone 'babe' until the next card. Every slip up = sip.
FINISH YOUR DRINK! Or distribute its contents among 3 other players.
